dev: hey all, first-day git hiccup. trying to push to git@github.com:redwood/inference-infra.git and get 'remote: Invalid username or password' even though i enabled 2FA last night. web UI also says 'You must enable 2FA' somehow. accepted invite with dev@personal.com and later with dev@redwood.com.
kate: welcome! do you see both emails listed on your GitHub account? if GH thinks your primary is personal it can conflict with SSO/org settings.
dev: i see two emails, primary is dev@personal.com. i added dev@redwood.com but didn't make it primary.
it-help: also run `ssh -T git@github.com` and paste the line it prints. sometimes your ssh-agent picks up a different key tied to another account.
dev: `ssh -T git@github.com` -> `Hi dev-old! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.` that's not my new account.
ops-bot: SCIM: user dev@redwood.com provisioned -> teams: infra, platform.
it-help: ok ssh key is wrong. check `ssh-add -l` to list keys the agent is offering. if it shows an old ed25519 key, either remove it (`ssh-add -d /path/to/key`) or create a host alias in ~/.ssh/config:
```
Host github-redwood
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood
```
then clone/push using git@github-redwood:redwood/inference-infra.git.
dev: `ssh-add -l` shows two keys, one labeled dev-old@gmail.com and one dev@redwood.com. i ran `ssh-add -D` then `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood`. `ssh -T git@github.com` now -> `Hi dev! You've successfully authenticated...`
kate: also switch your primary email in GitHub to dev@redwood.com so SSO maps correctly. i can resend the org invite to the work email if needed.
dev: changed primary email, re-accepted the work invite, and pushed successfully. thanks! :tada: will update the onboarding checklist to remind new hires about primary email + ssh-agent issues.
it-help: adding ticket to onboarding docs to include ssh-agent troubleshooting and example ~/.ssh/config. welcome aboard!
